svg.title: 17-paper-claim
svg.desc: Supported model-level Q2 argument: independent finite bulk coefficient, disproportionately large higher moments, and finite-device conductivity still increasing through1.5micrometres are distinct facts. The latest interior interval is a scalar-based comparison using the saved central-half coefficient at1.5micrometres. Earlier fit windows and raw profiles are not exported, and a matched software-runtime comparison is not independently established. The stronger paper test is a no-fit wavelength prediction and contacted-resistance prediction from one matched kernel, with infrared sampling refinement. No universal nonanalytic silicon exponent, contacted crossover length, microscopic thermalization rate or completed predictive locality criterion is asserted.

g.text: Next: predict wavelength response and contacted resistance
from the same microscopic exchange kernel.
